records.title: Faculty and support staff in AIIMS
details: Sir, I assure the hon. Member that I will look into the matter as far as the roster is concerned.

records.title: Closure of Government Schools
details: Yes, it might be a good model and certainly I will look into that.

records.title: Regional Air Connectivity in Tamil Nadu.
details: The 'International Airport' status is also under active consideration and the connectivity that has been mentioned by the hon. Member, will also be taken up with the selected airlines which will have the capacity to run it. However, the Government of India, particularly the Ministry of Civil Aviation, considers Madurai a very important destination, both domestically and internationally, and we will promote it from our side.

records.title: AMRIT BHARAT STATION SCHEME IN TAMIL NADU
details: 77 stations which have been taken up under Amrit Bharat Station Scheme. I can give the detailed list to the hon. Member. In fact the entire progress is known to most of the hon. Members who are active in their areas and of there is any particular station where there is any specific problem pointed out by any hon. Member, I make a request to hon. Members to please bring the issue to me. Certainly, I would like to solve it as soon as possible.

records.title: Restructured skill India Programme
details:
Shri B. Manickam Tagore asked for the marginalized section as well as aspirational districts. I will share the district-wise date if available with us.
I will share the data with Shri Manickam Tagore.

records.title: New Rule For International Container Lines
details: (a) to (f): This draft notification also proposes a mechanism for monitoring compliance through the Directorate General of Shipping, with regular reporting and oversight. Based on this draft notification, no order has been issued by Government till now.
